import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 19

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/



namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture19

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 19](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

If `G` is connected then the size `b(G)` of a largest induced bipartite subgraph
satisfies
`b(G) ≥ FLOOR((∑ ecc(v))/(|V|) + sSup (range (l G)))`, where `ecc(v)` denotes
eccentricity and `l(G)` is the independence number of neighbourhoods.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture19 (G : SimpleGraph α) [Nontrivial α] (h_conn : G.Connected) :
    ⌊(∑ v ∈ Finset.univ, ((G.eccent v).toNat : ℝ)) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) +
      sSup (Set.range (indepNeighbors G))⌋ ≤ b G := by
  sorry

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture19

reformulations.difference: Lean additionally assumes [Nontrivial α], whereas the source states the conjecture for simple connected graphs without explicitly excluding the one-vertex graph.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The only connected finite case omitted is the one-vertex graph. Its eccentricity and local independence number are both zero, while its bipartite number is one, so the inequality holds. Thus restricting the universally quantified conjecture to nontrivial vertex types is equivalent to the source formulation. This equivalence was proved as ReviewEquivalence.nontrivial_restriction_equivalent in /workspace/review/equivalence.lean, without using the conjecture or sorryAx.

review.notes: The sole theorem matches the source's inequality and definitions. The live website timed out; the latest available archived list, dated July 26, 2026, marks Conjecture 19 O (open), consistent with the file. Finiteness and connectedness ensure finite eccentricities, so ENat.toNat does not introduce its infinity default. The real supremum is an attained maximum of local independence numbers, the denominator is positive, and b counts vertices of a largest induced bipartite subgraph. Independent Lean checks established these interpretation and boundary facts, including the full K₂ instance. Computable sanity tests found no failures among all 772 connected labeled graphs of orders one through five. Successful experiments are in /workspace/review/{checks,equivalence,boundary,evaluate,enumerate}.lean. The reviewed file was not modified.
